name: Book shelves
description: Find books in your Calibre library by title, author, series or tag, see one book's details, keep your own named shelves, and get a few plain suggestions of what to read next. It only reads the Calibre library; it does not open, convert or change books, does not change Calibre's own shelves or tags, and its suggestions follow plain rules, not the brain.
author: Cypher Sisters

tools.set_library: Set the Calibre library folder to read books from (the folder that holds metadata.db). It is only read, never changed.
tools.find_books: Search the Calibre book library by title words, author, series or tag. Shows up to 20 books with authors, series, year and formats.
tools.book_details: Everything the library knows about one book: authors, series, year, formats, tags, the description, and which of your shelves it is on.
tools.shelves: List your book shelves, or the books on one shelf.
tools.shelf_add: Put a book from the library on one of your shelves. Makes the shelf if it is new.
tools.shelf_remove: Take a book off one of your shelves.
tools.recommend: Suggest a few books to read from the library: the newest added, by a tag or an author, that are not on a Read shelf. Plain rules, not the brain.
tools.library_stats: How big the Calibre library is: books, authors, series, tags, formats and the newest book.

setup_steps.title: Point it at your Calibre library
setup_steps.why: Book shelves reads your books from the Calibre library on this computer. It only reads it, never changes it.
setup_steps.text: Find the folder: open Calibre, click the Library button (the books icon) and choose Switch/create library; the folder shown there holds metadata.db. Then tell your bot: my Calibre library is in <that folder>.

consent: Book shelves reads the Calibre library on this computer, read-only, and never changes it. Your shelves and the library folder are kept in its own data folder on this computer. It does not use the internet.
